MtMoon_B2F_Text_MiguelIntro:
Hey, stop!
I found these fossils! They're both mine!
MtMoon_B2F_Text_WellEachTakeAFossil: We'll each take a fossil! No being greedy!
MtMoon_B2F_Text_ThenThisFossilIsMine: All right. Then this fossil is mine!
MtMoon_B2F_Text_LabOnCinnabarRegenerates:
Far away, on CINNABAR ISLAND, there's a POKéMON LAB.
They do research on regenerating fossils.
MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt1Intro:
We, TEAM ROCKET, shall find the fossils!
Reviving POKéMON from them will earn us huge riches!
MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle: You made me mad! TEAM ROCKET will blacklist you!
MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt2Intro: We, TEAM ROCKET, are POKéMON gangsters! We strike fear with our strength!
MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle: Darn it all! My associates won't stand for this!
MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt3Intro: We're pulling a big job here! Get lost, kid!
MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle: If you find a fossil, give it to me and scram!
MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt4Intro:
Little kids shouldn't be messing around with grown-ups!
It could be bad news!
MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt4PostBattle: POKéMON lived here long before people came.
MtMoon_B2F_Text_YouWantDomeFossil: Do you want the DOME FOSSIL?
MtMoon_B2F_Text_YouWantHelixFossil: Do you want the HELIX FOSSIL?
